decisions.text: type thin_bar: individual irregular events: thin bars at their instants on a true time axis, never a standard line (G1.54)
18 events as thin bars, each at its instant, 2.8 pt wide (D-42), rising from zero; nothing drawn between them (an event dated to the day sits in the middle of its day)
events at the same time stacked with a hairline gap, each its own length (D-42): July 3, 2022 (2), July 5, 2022 (2)
a true time axis (G2.42), from the first value to the end of the last event's day: June 20, 2022 to July 16, 2022
the unit phrase on the top label: “$6,000 (amount of each sale)”; the top gridline starts after it
a true time axis (G2.42): row 1 days, every second, restarting in each group, each centred on its span
time axis on two levels: row 2 June 2022, July 2022, dividers between the groups
time axis: the first and last labels kept 3 pt clear of the outer dividers, centred on their periods, which start 1.9 pt in from the left divider and end 0.0 pt before the right one

source.shows: individual sales at irregular times: a thin bar at each sale's instant, rising from zero, nothing drawn between them (G7.20); two sales on the same day stacked with a hairline gap, each its own length (D-42), so the scale reaches their total; days on row 1, every second, the months under them
